title: Performance Lab
description: Write up experiments with numbers, graphs, and explanations:
requirements: Row vs column traversal; AoS vs SoA; `vector` vs `list` vs `deque` for various ops
Branch prediction (sorted vs unsorted), branchless versions
Virtual vs CRTP vs `std::variant` vs `std::function` dispatch
Auto-vectorization: write a loop that vectorizes, break it, fix it (check the assembly on godbolt.org, in your browser)
All in Release builds, with CPU frequency notes. Time them with `std::chrono::steady_clock` here; Google Benchmark is the next step, on your own machine
